292K likes, 3,895 comments - mrwhosetheboss on August 22, 2026: "Life this week 🥹

About to show little boss the big world 

Welcome home buddy 🫡

Like father…👨🏽

Keeping this man warm at all costs 

Yes I’ve spent most of the week reclined 

“Why does this weird man keep staring at me”

Dhrisha’s recovering amazing ❤️‍🩹

Grocery shopping - he did not like the fridge section 😂

Amazing how quick you get used to one-handed-dad-mode 

Cutest little face 😊".
